title: Ten ones make a new ten

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: What happens when the ones reach ten? The blocks show thirty-six. Add seven ones. What is the new total?

do.text: The blocks show $36$. Add $7$ ones. What is the new total?

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Six ones need four more to make ten. So split seven into four and three.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: One, two, three, four. Now there are ten ones.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Ten ones join into one rod.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The new rod slides over to the tens: forty. Three ones are still waiting.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The blocks show fifty-two. Add six ones. What is the new total?

do.text: The blocks show $52$. Add $6$ ones. What is the new total?

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Two ones plus six ones makes eight ones.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Eight is fewer than ten, so no new rod. Only the ones digit changes.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Five tens and eight ones: fifty-eight.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The blocks show fifty-two. Add three tens. What is the new total?

do.text: The blocks show $52$. Add $3$ tens. What is the new total?

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Three tens means thirty. Join rods to rods.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Eight tens, two ones: eighty-two. The ones stay the same.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The blocks show sixty-seven. Add six ones. What is the new total?

do.text: The blocks show $67$. Add $6$ ones. What is the new total?

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Seven plus six is thirteen. Six tens and thirteen ones: I'll write six, thirteen.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: But thirteen ones cannot fit in the ones place. Ten of them join into a new ten.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: That new ten joins my six tens. Seven tens and three ones: seventy-three.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Add the ones. Group ten of them into a new ten, and keep the rest as ones. This is regrouping.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Ten ones make a new ten.
